title: The tunnel to nowhere
text: A miner named William "Burro" Schmidt dug a tunnel through the El Paso Mountains with a pick, a shovel, a four-pound hammer, and carefully placed dynamite. He began in 1906, and by 1938 he had reached his goal. Schmidt said he would never haul his ore to the Mojave smelter down the back trail with his two burros. A road from Last Chance Canyon to Mojave was completed in 1920, but he kept digging. He never used the tunnel to carry ore.

s2.title: Burro Schmidt's Tunnel
s2.quote: Even after he had finished his tunnel, he never transported an ounce of ore through it.
